verdict.rationale: Twilio Video is a developer video API/SDK platform. A product like this could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant in its console or tooling, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. AI-powered noise cancellation, real-time transcription and an llms.txt file are adjacent features, not a task-delegating assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
